dataIdInfo.idPurp: Land use data summarized by comid (NHD Catchment) used to assess riparian buffer condition
dataIdInfo.idAbs:
NLCD land cover data for 2001, 2004, 2006, 2008, 2011, 2013, 2016, and 2019 was reclassed to include only developed, forest, and grass (herbaceous) land cover. After reclassification the raster was clipped to a 20, 40, 60, 80, 100, 300, and 400 ft buffer of NHD flowlines, water bodies, and water areas.

Zonal Histograms were run for each reclassed and clipped land use raster in preparation as input for 00_ProcessRiparianData-Northeast.R.

dataSource.srcDesc: NLCD Land use classification was used as the basis of this dataset. Dewitz, J., and U.S. Geological Survey, 2021, National Land Cover Database (NLCD) 2019 Products (2001-2019 data): U.S. Geological Survey data release

stepSrc.srcDesc: Dewitz, J., and U.S. Geological Survey, 2021, National Land Cover Database (NLCD) 2019 Products (2001-2019 data): U.S. Geological Survey data release

prcStep.stepDesc: Reclassified land used was clipped to buffer mask - 20,40,60, 80, 100, 300, or 400 ft.

Zonal Histograms were run on reclassed landuse clipped to buffer with catchments from NHD used as the zones. Note: featurd in catchments = comid. The output zonal histogram table was converted to a .csv file using python. The featurd field was renamed comid.
